messages:
marta: Heads-up — canary for release/runtime-2.14 shows a decode path perf regression. p95 up ~32% on short-seq workloads after the merge (commit abc1234).
ci-bot: perf-checker: https://ci.redwood/board/12345 test=decode-shortseq result=fail (p95 +32%)
sam: Oof. Which subsystems are spiking? kernel selection, batching, or KV activity?
marta: Kernel selector logs and perf traces look suspicious. Short snippet below: 
```
[2026-03-17T15:03:12Z] kernel_selector: model=redwood/llm-v1 seq=16 batch=8 chosen=attn_fused_v2 reason=policy_kernel_score+0.12
[2026-03-17T15:03:12Z] runtime: decode.p95.before=48ms after=64ms
[2026-03-17T15:03:12Z] kv_cache: memcpy_calls=4234 memcpy_bytes=12.3MB
```
jess: Is attn_fused_v2 the new fused-softmax path from PR#5021? That one changed numerics + routing heuristics.
marta: Yeah PR#5021 landed in the runtime merge. It updates fused ops and also updated the kernel-routing policy table to prefer fused v2 for fp16 devices.
dmitri: I kicked off a bisect locally. Suspect area: the kernel-routing delta that introduced an extra memcopy path for partial KV spans. Bisect command I used: `git bisect start HEAD v2.13 && git bisect run ./tools/perf/run_shortseq.sh`
ci-bot: perf job triggered: job/board/12345/attempt/7 (logs streaming)
sam: If the bisect points to PR#5021, let's revert on canary and re-run perf. deploy-bot: Rollout hold applied: INF-234 — automatic hold due to perf regression. No auto-promote.
marta: Minimal reproducer: `./run_perf.sh --model llm-v1 --seq 16 --batch 8 --iters 200 --trace=kernel-selector` Results I see: before-merge p95 ~48ms, after-merge p95 ~64ms, decode token throughput down ~18%.
jess: Can you paste the kernel-selector config change? Even a 1-line policy weight tweak could cause the wrong kernel to be picked for short sequences.
marta: Config diff (excerpt):
```
- policy_table[attn_v1] = base_score
- policy_table[attn_fused_v2] += 0.12  # prefer fused path on fp16
+ policy_table[attn_fused_v2] += 0.12
+ kernel_route.prefetch_kv_threshold = 64  # new default in PR#5021
```
dmitri: That prefetch_kv_threshold bump looks like the culprit — it increases partial-prefetch memcopies for short-seq batches, causing extra memcpy + kernel syncs. Bisect so far narrowed to commit c9f8e7b which introduced both the fused kernel and the prefetch threshold change.
sam: Plan: 1) Revert c9f8e7b on canary, 2) run the shortseq perf suite, 3) if p95 back to baseline, cut hotfix that splits the changes (separate fused kernel enable from prefetch threshold).
ci-bot: perf job finished: p95 reverted to baseline on revert-build (candidate revert confirmed)
deploy-bot: Canary rollback executed for node-pool runtime-canary-2 (rollback id rb-778) — rollout remains blocked until follow-up PRs merge.
jess: Add a CI perf guard: assert decode_shortseq.p95 <= 55ms on canary builds and annotate PR if kernel routing table changed.
marta: I'll open PR to split the changes, add more guardrails, and add a microbenchmark for prefetch behavior. Posting initial artifacts here: https://artifacts.redwood/ci/12345/trace.tar.gz
sam: I'll own the revert follow-up, pinging @dmitri and @marta to work the patch. ETA 90m for hotfix + canary verification.
marta: OK — will attach bisect log and perf traces when done. :thumbsup:
